newsitem.title: JAPAN: Singapore PM Goh to visit Japan next week.
newsitem.headline: Singapore PM Goh to visit Japan next week.

text.p: Singapore's Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong will visit Japan next week to discuss with his Japanese counterpart the situation in the east Asia region, including Cambodia, Japan's Foreign Ministry said on Tuesday.
Goh, who will be in Tokyo from August 27 to 30, will hold talks with Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto during his stay, ministry officials said.

"But there are no immediate issues pending between Japan and Singapore, and discussions will probably centre around the east Asian situation in general, including developments in Cambodia and China," a Foreign Ministry official said.
Goh and Hashimoto are also expected to discuss Japan's relations with the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN), he said.

It will be Goh's third visit to Japan since he became prime minister in September 1991. Goh's previous visit was in November 1995, when he attended the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum in the western Japanese city of Osaka. -- Tokyo Newsroom (813) 3432-8018
